description:
Role: ETL Developer with SAP 
 Location: Fort Worth TX 
 
 Job Description: 
 • 7 + years of experience in the design, development and implementation of ETL processes 
 • Extensive experience with enterprise level ETL tools - SAP Data Integrator, SAP BI BO, SAP BODS, Reporting, Universe Designing 
 • Design processes to extract, transform and load the source data to the target data warehouse and Data lake. 
 • Strong SQL development experience using T-SQL, PL/SQL 
 • Exposure to OLAP, OLTP, data warehouse, data mart development, fact and dimensional database design. 
 • Experience in Performance tuning and end-to-end lifecycle with Enterprise wide data warehouse 
 • Review ETL production design for performance optimization. 
 • Create documentation & flow charts of systems, business processes and databases 
 • Excellent technical, logical, analytical and problem-solving skills to provide insight on development and application support. 

 Graduates

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
